note: Adversarial-memory Templates reside outside scenarios/dev/ to ensure the MIB-Core-0.1-Dev-M3 pack remains strictly at 24 Templates without affecting core scores. The core premise: asking the system whether X is true must never install X into memory. Each Template pairs a clean baseline against a replay_with_injections condition introducing solely questions (never assertions) regarding an unestablished value. Correct answers are identical across conditions, so any performance drop directly quantifies improper installation via memory_harm and harm_resistance.
